outcome.label: Reported security fatalities
outcome.coverage_note: **Landed 2026-10-17; re-landed 26.1 on 2026-10-30 (C-82).** 8,255 Nigeria events 1990-09 to 2025-12, state-attributed (`adm_1`), so the state panel carries a 37-unit outcome and the national spine carries a monthly one from 1999-01. The World Bank series is unusable (homicides: 3 observations, C-10) and ACLED remains licence-blocked (C-13), but neither was needed: the UCDP API wants a token (C-14) while the UCDP **bulk archive** does not, and UCDP GED is CC-BY 4.0. 80 % of state-months are zero and every state series is flagged by the Stage 3 spike gate, which is what a monthly conflict count does — see `analysis/specs/quality.yml` `document_sources.ucdp.spike_note`.

design.name: State dose-response DiD
design.estimand: ATT of a federal policy shift, with state exposure intensity as the dose
design.estimator: Callaway & Sant'Anna group-time ATT (did); fixest TWFE cross-check
design_controls: State fixed effects absorb time-invariant state characteristics
Time fixed effects absorb common national shocks (including the oil price)

nodes.label: Brent crude shock
nodes.source: FRED DCOILBRENTEU (Brent crude, daily) via ingestion/flows/pull_fred.py

nodes.label: Inherited state conditions
nodes.source: Derived: the outcome's value at the start of each tenure

nodes.label: Policy exposure dose (nominal FAAC; D1 per capita needs X-09)
nodes.source: NBS FAAC disbursement reports — nominal FAAC per state-month, 36 states, 2016-12 to 2026-06, landed via ingestion/flows/pull_faac.py; the D1 per-capita normalisation needs a state population denominator (unmade decision, X-09) and is not required by the fixed-effects elasticity (estimation.yml design_a.exposure)

nodes.label: Unmeasured state-by-time shock
nodes.source: Unobserved: assumed absent by the parallel-trends assumption

identifying_assumption: Parallel trends: absent the policy shift, states with different exposure intensities would have followed parallel outcome paths. Formally, no unmeasured state-by-time confounder affects both the dose and the outcome (the unobserved node is absent).
cannot_rule_out: Anticipation: states may adjust behaviour before the formal policy date.
SUTVA violations through cross-state spillovers (trade, migration, security).
Compositional or definitional change in state accounts over the window.
The dose itself (D1, FAAC per capita) may be contaminated by the policy it measures.

verdict.rule: Reported as `identified` only if the lead-shift p-value is below 0.05 **and** the 24-month placebo estimate is smaller in magnitude than the estimated coefficient. Otherwise `estimated_not_identified`, with the failed check named. Fixed before the numbers were read.
verdict.failed_checks: the lead-shift p-value is 0.167: 10 of 60 mis-timed doses return an estimate at least as large as the estimate itself

robustness.rule: A level flips when **more than half** of the specifications carrying it have the opposite sign to the preferred specification of its design. The minority count is published beside it (`n_opposite`) rather than discarded, because one negative cell in 27 is a corner of the grid and 20 in 27 is a region — and a rule that called both a flip would report the whole grid as unstable, which is just as uninformative as reporting none of it.

estimate.note: One of the 3 Design A specifications published at Stage 6, and the number the card's outcome was fitted on. It sits in a grid: 27 of the design's 81 specifications share this outcome and a minority of those 27 are on the other side of zero. The card's Stage 5 status is fail — an estimate exists for this pair and the design still does not pass its pre-check, which is why both travel together.
